headline: Magmarex or Minespine
title: Magmarex or Minespine | Which Pebbling Final Form | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Pebbling ends in two stage three forms. Magmarex is Fire and Rock with one hundred and ten HP, ninety one attack and one hundred and four break. Minespine is pure Rock with one hundred and ten HP, ninety attack and ninety seven defense. Both evolve at level forty eight. Magmarex burns more, Minespine takes fewer weaknesses. Which one would you choose? Comment below!

description: Aniimo Pebbling final forms compared: Magmarex (Fire and Rock, HP 110, attack 91, break 104) versus Minespine (Rock, HP 110, attack 90, physical defense 97, break 105). Both evolve at level 48 and need their Alpha defeated. Checked on aniimo.gg and the Dexerto Aniimo wiki in November 2026.
joke: Choosing between Magmarex and Minespine is easy if you like either heat or crystals.
